prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 部分A股个股行情一览 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 7 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 17px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "代码" · longest unbreakable word 66px · one-line width 66px
  col 2: header "名称" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 70px
  col 3: header "最新价" · longest unbreakable word 67px · one-line width 67px
  col 4: header "涨跌幅" · longest unbreakable word 60px · one-line width 60px
  col 5: header "成交额（亿）" · longest unbreakable word 52px · one-line width 104px
  col 6: header "市盈率" · longest unbreakable word 39px · one-line width 53px
  col 7: header "所属行业" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 70px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 496px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 495px.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示部分A股个股行情，供读者按股票比较价格、涨跌、成交额、估值和所属行业。","reading":"读者先用代码或名称定位股票，再沿行读取行情；纵向扫描数值列可比较不同股票。名称和行业换行会增加部分行高，这些行的空白也可容纳同一行其他文本换行。","groups":["代码、名称：共同标识股票，代码是精确查找的关键。","最新价、涨跌幅：共同描述当前价格及其变化。","成交额（亿）、市盈率：分别提供交易规模和估值信息，都是用于纵向比较的数值列。","所属行业：提供股票分类，便于结合行情理解和比较。"],"keep_intact":["股票代码及各列完整数值，包括小数点、正负号、百分号和千位分隔符。"],"may_wrap":["股票名称和所属行业可在汉字间换行，但应保持同一单元格内的词语易读。","较长表头可换行，尤其是成交额（亿）；表头行高度可容纳这种换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [87, 51, 88, 81, 73, 60, 55] · table 496×803px · row heights [118, 118, 118, 118, 92, 118, 118] · column headers wrapped 4/7 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"代码和行情数值保持完整，股票可以准确定位，价格、涨跌幅等数值也便于纵向比较。成交额表头分行后仍能辨认。","problems":"名称和所属行业多数逐字竖排，使各行过高，同行数值下方出现大量空白；名称尤其难以作为股票标识快速识别。市盈率表头也被拆开，行业表头占据四行。","cause":"名称列宽51px、行业列宽55px，扣除21px内边距和边框后都不足以并排容纳两个约18px的汉字。市盈率列宽60px，容纳完整表头所需的宽度不足。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"名称优先","widths":[87,57,88,81,73,60,49],"change":"将行业列的6px移给名称列，使名称可按两个汉字一行排列，改善股票识别并缩短多行；行业仍可能逐字排列，但保留所有代码和数值的完整宽度。"},{"name":"行业优先","widths":[87,49,88,81,73,60,57],"change":"将名称列的2px移给行业列，使行业可按两个汉字一行排列，改善分类信息和行业表头的阅读；名称仍可能逐字排列，适合更重视行业比较的场景。"}]}
